_note: v2 hook overrides for la Banque du Village (B10_banque). Source hooks are kept where the painting shows them; these replace hooks whose painted scene differs, mostly to avoid text in the paintings and repeated motifs across the thirteen rooms.

fr_solde_noun_m.why: No letters are painted (no text in the paintings), so the stamp and the little balance scale carry the hook.

fr_reputation_noun.why: Painted as a lady with the star rather than a banker, because the bank already has several men in suits.

fr_consommation_noun.why: Painted as a grocery basket with a thermometer gauge instead of a brass shopping-bag dial.

fr_sou_noun.why: Matches the painting: a money box on the floor instead of a slot in the wall.

fr_portefeuille_noun.why: The notes are painted plainly, so the foil is only in the words.

fr_acces_noun.why: Pack C v2 (approved, 2b039891): AX sound-alike painted - the guard boy holds a woodcutter's ax beside the gate whose plank he chopped through. Replaces the key/padlock text. Owner ruling (Oct 29, 23:19 CT): an ax is a tool, not a weapon - AX hook approved, do not re-flag.

fr_gage_noun.why: There is no pawn desk; the boy hands the toy garage to a smaller child.

fr_transfert_noun.why: A real river seen through the window instead of a model river.

fr_centime_noun.why: Painted on the path outside, not on the parquet.

fr_enjeu_noun.why: Matches the painting: the coin is held over the board.

fr_paiement_noun.why: The coins fall into her hands from above; no second customer is painted.

fr_bancaire_adj.why: The card hangs on the window mullion, and it is blank (no text).

fr_emprunt_noun.why: A granny instead of a farmer, so the farmers are not repeated (one leads the goat in the placements office).

fr_debit_noun.why: A girl called Debbie instead of a bee, because the bees already do le bilan.

fr_allocation_noun.why: The cans are plain (no labels), because the paintings hold no text.

fr_notoriete_noun.why: Matches the painting: the fans hold papers to be signed.

fr_denomination_noun.why: Sorted by color and size, with no numbers, because the paintings hold no text.

fr_promotion_noun.why: The cone hat stands in for the megaphone, and the tag is blank.

fr_revenu_noun.why: The bag is plain, without a sticker.

fr_lot_noun.why: A girl surveyor instead of a farmer, to avoid repeating the farmers.

fr_taxe_noun.why: Round-headed brass tacks, so nothing sharp is shown.

fr_interet_noun.why: The in-tray is painted as a wire basket.

fr_economie_noun.why: Owner asked for a better hook than the echoing piggy bank; the word is a cognate, so the picture now shows an economy itself.

fr_dette_noun.why: The slip is blank (no IOU letters).

fr_faillite_noun.why: Repainted: no one throws anything now (owner disliked the coin-yeeting woman).

fr_opportunite_noun.why: The teacup sits on the step of the open door.

fr_capitalisme_noun.why: Respelled the sound-out (the v1 spelling trips the content word filter); the picture is unchanged.

fr_capital_adj.why: The gold petals are painted as gold coins.

fr_subvention_noun.why: A rolled grant scroll instead of a check, because the check already appears in the main hall.

fr_remboursement_noun.why: Only the running man is painted.

fr_debouche_noun.why: No cork is painted; the gold pours straight out of the pipe.

fr_expertise_noun.why: A parrot instead of a cat, to avoid repeating cats (the cat sits on the stock boxes).

fr_rentabilite_noun.why: A billy goat instead of a beehive, because the bees already do le bilan.

fr_crise_noun.why: Repainted: the banker now has two arms (the old picture showed three).

fr_investissement_noun.why: Repainted: bare soil and one sprout, no coin-covered bush.

fr_benefice_noun.why: Owner rule: the bunny IS the sound-alike, so it stays, but as a natural bunny (no apron, not standing like a person).

fr_compte_noun.why: The COUNT is the sound-alike, but the vampire costume was not: scary figures do not suit an all-ages bank, so he is now a friendly nobleman.

fr_retrait_noun.why: Paint-back (sparse rule): plan-only since p16 (from camping/souche), planned R_bank_counter_02 = banque/guichet; painted in the right window pane, guichet 5 -> 6.

fr_ducat_noun.why: Paint-back (sparse rule): plan-only since p12 (from route/consigne), planned for banque/banque (full at 10); re-planned to the loans shelf zoom (R_bank_counter_03 / R_bank_counter_03_z1), pupitre 3 -> 4.

fr_essor_noun.why: Paint-back: plan-only since p11 (from aeroport/aeroport), planned R_bank_economy_02; painted into its zoom banque/tableau (6 -> 7). The eagle hook is kept.

fr_banquier_noun.why: Matches the painting (pack C v2 bureau: the banker holds up a big brass key with a clock in it).
